08961769b5ed0926.description: CMA CGM, Saudi Arabia, is staffed with knowledgeable and motivated industry professionals who work closely with its customers to provide them with the best possible service and high-quality transport of their cargo. As a result of expanding our organization, we are currently looking for a Customer Service Officer to join our fast-growing and challenging organization. Position: Customer Services Officer Location: Jeddah Job Overview: The Customer Service Officer is responsible for managing customer inquiries, resolving complaints, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction throughout the shipping process. This role collaborates closely with internal teams to ensure timely case resolution, communicate shipment updates, and optimize service delivery. The ideal candidate will leverage strong communication and problem-solving skills to improve customer experience, monitor key performance indicators, and support continuous process improvement. Advanced Desk Responsibilities: Single-entry point for all customer care queries Full case ownership throughout the entire lifecycle – no forwarding to other departments Respond to customer calls, cases, and chats within SLA timelines Handle complaints and shipment disruptions professionally and efficiently Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution Communicate with customers regarding operational updates (vessel delays, rollovers, etc.) Follow up on customer KPIs such as FCRR, TAT, and NPS Conduct regular meetings with customers to drive continuous improvement Identify and promote value-added services (VAS) such as Carrier Haulage or VGM Standard Desk: Manage all cases based on FIFO (First In – First Out) principle Promote and guide customers through the digital journey for a more efficient experience Special Desk: Handle Direct Delivery and Breakbulk shipments Execute and follow up on delivery processes Manage tailored solutions for special cargo and commodities Regularly meet with customers to review business needs Act as setup point for special exceptions (e.g., fruit, cross-sell, etc.) Qualifications & Profile: 2-4 years of experience in Shipping & Logistics Strong customer and vendor relationship management skills Proven ability to drive change, innovation, and process improvement Excellent communication, presentation, and decision-making skills Team player with a proactive and professional attitude Proficient in MS Office applications Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

081b5c43636e0042.job_title: Assistant Director of People and Culture Four Seasons Resort and Residences Red Sea at Shura Island
081b5c43636e0042.company_name: Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts, Saudi Arabia
081b5c43636e0042.description: About the Role Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts, Saudi Arabia, is seeking an Assistant Director of People and Culture to join the team at the new Four Seasons Resort Red Sea at Shura Island. This full-time role is based in the Red Sea destination, located between Umluj and Al Wajh, Saudi Arabia. The Assistant Director will report to the Director of People and Culture and will be instrumental in leading the People and Culture strategy and overseeing daily operations. The Red Sea Destination The Red Sea destination is being developed as a luxury beachside destination along 200 km of coastline, focusing on sustainable practices and tourism. The new Four Seasons Resort on Shura Island will feature approximately 149 rooms and suites, six restaurant and lounge outlets, meeting and events spaces, a marine discovery center, and comprehensive leisure facilities including a spa, tennis courts, and multiple pools. This development emphasizes environmental conservation and relies on renewable energy. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee the day-to-day operations of the People & Culture Department and collaborate on strategy implementation. Act as an objective third party in employee counselling, problem-solving, and conflict resolution. Identify, analyze, and resolve patterns of unsatisfactory employee turnover. Assist in managing the departmental budget, including benefits, labor and salary reporting, and planning cost-effective events. Oversee regular audits of insurance, immigration, labor records, and paid-time-off allowances. Monitor and ensure organizational compliance with local employment laws and regulations; review and revise policies as needed. Act as a liaison between employees and management regarding company policies and regulations. Work closely with Finance on labor meetings, employee attestations, and wage and hour training. Supervise employee programs such as recognition celebrations, community outreach, and staff events. Respond to employee claims, Workers’ Compensation matters, Leaves of Absence, and Wage & Hour inquiries. Participate as an active member of the Health, Safety and Security Committee. Work professionally with all staff while maintaining confidentiality of People & Culture information. Oversee the hiring process and support the Talent Acquisition Manager. Lead People & Culture metrics and reporting efforts, providing updates on employee performance and turnover. Manage People & Culture budgets, ensuring cost-effective strategies and resource allocation. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in People and Culture leadership, with a demonstrated passion for creating a positive employee experience. The role requires a professional who can lead day-to-day operations and contribute to strategic initiatives within a luxury hospitality environment. Compensation and Benefits Competitive salary in a tax-free environment. 30 days of vacation plus public holidays. Complimentary meals and uniform cleaning. Medical and life insurance. Employee Assistance Program and worldwide complimentary room nights. Opportunities for growth and development. Additional family benefits. Application Process Join a team committed to delivering exceptional guest experiences through genuine care and warm hospitality. We are dedicated to attracting, developing, and retaining talented professionals to uphold the Four Seasons service standard.

08db0c1a70f1174d.description: About the Role FNRCO is seeking a Managed Services Consultant with substantial hands-on experience in Splunk Enterprise administration, SIEM content development, Splunk Enterprise Security (ES), and Splunk User Behavior Analytics (UBA). This full-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Administer Splunk Enterprise, covering deployment, user management, licensing, upgrades, patches, configuration, change management, reporting, backup, and recovery. Onboard, monitor, and troubleshoot log sources to ensure continuous log ingestion. Develop and maintain security use cases, correlation rules, dashboards, alerts, reports, report templates, and SPL queries using Splunk Enterprise Security. Review existing Splunk configurations and recommend enhancements. Manage SIEM support tickets and resolve log-source ingestion issues. Develop custom parsing rules for non-standard logs. Configure threat feeds, Indicators of Compromise (IoCs), Sigma rules, and security advisories. Support regulatory audits in Saudi Arabia and provide required evidence from the SIEM solution. Administer Splunk UBA, including ingestion of CIM-compliant data, raw events, and HR data from the Splunk platform. Monitor Splunk UBA health using the UBA Monitoring App and manage backups and failover procedures. Required Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 5 years of relevant Splunk/SIEM experience. Strong expertise in Splunk Enterprise administration. Hands-on experience with Splunk Enterprise Security and SIEM use-case development. Experience in Splunk UBA administration, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Required Skills Knowledge of log onboarding, parsing, SPL queries, and correlation searches. Understanding of threat intelligence and security compliance requirements. Work Location This full-time position is located in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

081ca2b2f9bb1131.description: About the Role Nissan is seeking a Section Manager Digital Transformation to lead digital transformation, business intelligence, data analytics, systems integration, automation, data governance, and artificial intelligence initiatives. This full-time role focuses primarily on transforming Sales Performance, Dealer Network Development (DND), and Non-Technical Training through integrated data, digital tools, governed BI, and automation. The position is based in Saudi Arabia. Key Responsibilities Own and maintain the prioritized transformation roadmap and backlog, with a primary focus on Sales Performance, DND, and Non-Technical Training. Map current processes, identify manual activities, and redesign priority workflows using approved digital solutions. Develop or coordinate internal solutions including dealer assessment, DND expansion tracking, training/certification tools, and reporting automation. Assess vendor technical proposals, architecture, scalability, integration approach, security, and total cost of ownership before solution selection. Measure benefit realization, including hours saved, cycle-time reduction, errors reduced, cost avoidance, and user adoption. Own the evolution of the Sales Performance Dashboard into an integrated performance-management environment. Establish Power BI architecture, dashboard/UI standards, reusable data models, governed workspaces, and deployment processes in coordination with IT. Define common KPI architecture covering source, owner, logic, target, frequency, and management use. Build executive, functional, dealer, and operational views with drill-down capabilities. Expand analytics progressively to DND, Training, CX, CCS, Production, and other approved functions. Map current-state systems, interfaces, data flows, ownership, and dependencies across various platforms. Identify manual interfaces, duplicate data handling, quality gaps, and system limitations; define future-state integration priorities. Document API/interface requirements, data mappings, business rules, transformation logic, and source-of-truth ownership. Coordinate technical feasibility with Local IT, Regional IS/IT, and enterprise system owners. Maintain the Current-State System Map, Future-State Architecture, Data Flow Map, Integration Catalogue, Interface/API Register, and Application Dependency Map. Lead workshops to convert problems and opportunities into Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Act as the business-side technical owner between functions, Local IT, and Regional IS/IT. Coordinate feasibility assessment, solution design, development priorities, testing, UAT, defect resolution, and go-live activities. Maintain a Digital Transformation Dependency & Risk Register. Develop a practical, governed AI roadmap focused on measurable business outcomes. Prioritize approved AI use cases across forecasting, lead scoring, conversion analysis, and training analytics. Drive approved Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled productivity use cases with appropriate controls. Prototype and technically evaluate AI/automation opportunities, then coordinate scale-up. Define value case, success measure, and control requirements for every use case. Establish and maintain a data-governance operating model covering data ownership, authoritative source, KPI definition, quality rules, and lineage. Maintain Data Dictionary, KPI Dictionary, System/Data Map, Data Ownership Matrix, Data Quality Rules, and Reporting Governance Framework. Work within Nissan/NKSA architecture and cybersecurity governance, ensuring role-based access and privacy-by-design. Coordinate resolution of material data-quality and reconciliation issues. Manage the solution lifecycle from problem definition through development, integration, testing, training, go-live, and enhancement. Coordinate with Executive Management, Sales, DND, Training, CX, Finance, Marketing/Aftersales, Local IT, Regional IS/IT/AMIEO, dealers, platform owners, and technology vendors. Drive user readiness, training, adoption, and change management. Track business benefits and continuous-improvement opportunities; maintain lessons learned and enhancement backlog. Provide concise, governed management insights and support monthly/quarterly business reviews. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Engineering, or equivalent. Minimum 8 years of relevant professional experience, preferably with ownership of enterprise-scale solutions across Digital Transformation, Enterprise Software, Data/BI, Systems Integration, API development/integration, Data Modelling, Automation, Business Applications, AI implementation, or Solution Delivery. Strongly preferred: Experience in automotive, dealer operations, CRM/lead management, automotive finance, financial services, or enterprise transformation. Mandatory: Excellent English communication skills (spoken and written). Arabic language skills are preferred but not mandatory. Work Type This is a full-time position.

082505bb3c432208.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رواد الإنشاءات الحديثة القابضة عن مدير عمليات تشغيل للانضمام إلى فريقها في شرورة، نجران. يتولى مدير عمليات التشغيل الإشراف المباشر على فريق التشغيل والصيانة في موقع العمل بمنطقة الربع الخالي، ويقود أعمال التشغيل اليومية لضمان تنفيذها وفق الخطط والإجراءات المعتمدة، مع الحفاظ على جودة الأداء واستمرارية الخدمات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف المباشر على أعضاء فريق التشغيل والصيانة ومتابعة تنفيذ المهام اليومية. توزيع الأعمال والمهام على أفراد الفريق بناءً على الأولويات واحتياجات الموقع. متابعة أعمال التشغيل والصيانة لضمان إنجازها في الوقت المحدد. الإشراف على أعمال الصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية ضمن نطاق الفريق. رصد الأعطال والملاحظات التشغيلية والفنية ورفعها للمشرف العام. متابعة معالجة الأعطال والملاحظات والتأكد من إغلاقها بشكل فعال. إجراء الجولات الميدانية ومتابعة حالة المرافق والمعدات ضمن نطاق المسؤولية. التأكد من التزام أفراد الفريق بتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية. متابعة الالتزام بأوقات العمل والحضور والانصراف ورفع أي ملاحظات للجهة المختصة. التنسيق مع فرق التشغيل والصيانة الأخرى عند الحاجة لضمان استمرارية العمل. متابعة استخدام الأدوات والمعدات ومواد الصيانة والمحافظة عليها. التأكد من المحافظة على مرافق الموقع وممتلكاته. إعداد ورفع التقارير اليومية أو الدورية عن الأعمال المنجزة والملاحظات والأعطال. الإبلاغ الفوري عن الحالات الطارئة أو الأعطال التي قد تؤثر على استمرارية التشغيل. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الشركة والتعليمات المعتمدة بالموقع. تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى ذات علاقة يتم تكليفه بها من المسؤول المباشر. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال التشغيل والصيانة. القدرة على الإشراف المباشر على فرق العمل وتوجيهها. فهم جيد لإجراءات التشغيل والصيانة الوقائية والتصحيحية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. القدرة على حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات التشغيلية. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل وإعداد التقارير. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويتطلب العمل في موقع الربع الخالي، مع الإشراف المباشر على فرق التشغيل والصيانة لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

0825eace8dbf85f5.description: About the Role IHG Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Sales Manager for a full-time position in Riyadh, Riyadh. This role is responsible for developing and implementing sales and marketing strategies for the hotel to achieve positive goal attainment. The Sales Manager will focus on selling hotel rooms, meeting spaces, and food and beverage services through direct client contact. Key Responsibilities Manage daily activities, plan, and assign tasks to ensure adequate staffing within the sales team. Support the sales team through training and feedback to improve performance and set individual development goals. Ensure colleagues are trained on required standards and provided with necessary tools for efficient work. Assist with team-related issues, including recommending performance improvements. Foster teamwork by building strong relationships among different departments. Financial Objectives Work towards achieving set sales targets and increasing overall profitability. Assist in achieving expected revenues by participating in budget preparation and financial planning. Develop and implement sales plans aimed at increasing occupancy, raising average rates, and boosting food and beverage sales. Prepare regular reports and market analysis to guide business activities and increase revenue. Guest Experience and Client Relations Provide assistance to guests requiring support or information. Offer guests information about programs, local attractions, and restaurants to enhance their experience. Build relationships with key clients to enhance group sales opportunities. Coordinate activities between sales and other departments to ensure high-quality service delivery. Business Development and Collaboration Enhance the hotel's reputation and brand within the local community. Work on improving marketing activities and overall hotel sales performance in collaboration with other departments. Execute additional tasks as needed to ensure smooth operations. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in sales, preferably within the hospitality sector. This position encompasses sales responsibilities in a hotel, which may include managing some administrative aspects of sales.

082cfce71bad7c71.description: About the Role Modern Mills For Food Products Co. is seeking a Senior Application Administrator to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time role focuses on ensuring the availability, performance, and maintenance of enterprise applications, with a primary focus on Sales Force Automation (SFA) applications and their integration with the ERP system. The position requires 2-5 years of experience. Job Purpose The Senior Application Administrator is responsible for the administration of application configurations, monitoring operations, coordinating upgrades, training users, and providing expert support to users and stakeholders. This role is key to enhancing sales and business operations through effective digital solutions. Key Responsibilities Manage and maintain critical business applications to ensure high availability, integrity, and optimal performance. Act as System Administrator for Sales Force Automation applications (*, Sonic), covering user setup, configuration, version control, and troubleshooting. Coordinate and execute application patching, upgrades, and configuration changes. Support handheld devices and mobile device management tools used by field sales teams. Serve as the primary point of contact for integration issues between the main ERP system, GFSA, and SFA applications, ensuring accurate data flow and synchronization. Collaborate with vendors and internal stakeholders for smooth integration, handover, and implementation of third-party applications. Act as the primary point of contact for application-related issues, resolving incidents within defined SLAs. Log, track, and close user issues through the ManageEngine ticketing system. Conduct root cause analysis of recurring issues and recommend long-term solutions. Report infrastructure issues affecting supervised applications to the infrastructure team. Monitor application performance and generate regular health, utilization, and quality reports. Prepare operational and management reports as required, utilizing SQL and reporting tools. Maintain application documentation, including configuration guides, SOPs, and recovery procedures. Participate in disaster recovery planning and execution for supported applications. Collaborate with business users to gather and refine application requirements or enhancements. Participate in the implementation and rollout of new applications across branches, such as SFA rollouts and CRM integration with SAP. Assist in user acceptance testing (UAT) and post-deployment support of new application functionalities. Train employees on supported applications as requested by IT management or user managers. Support internal audit, compliance, and cybersecurity teams with application-specific evidence and reports. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, cybersecurity protocols, and regulatory requirements. Comply with the company's Code of Conduct and safety protocols. Experience and Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in application administration. Demonstrated experience with Sales Force Automation (SFA) applications. Experience with ERP system integration. Proficiency in SQL and reporting tools. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, within a professional work environment focused on maintaining and enhancing digital solutions for business operations.

08466bd0336eeb62.description: About the Role Petrocon Engineers & Consultants is seeking a DCS SCADA & Automation Commissioning Engineer to join their team in Al Wajh, Tabuk. This full-time position is critical for supporting commissioning, system integration, start-up, and operational readiness activities for the AMAALA Project in Saudi Arabia. The role requires a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, with a strong emphasis on immediate availability. Key Responsibilities Execute commissioning activities for DCS, PLC, SCADA, and industrial automation systems. Conduct Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), loop checks, functional testing, and troubleshooting. Support system integration, plant start-up, and operational readiness initiatives. Coordinate effectively with engineering, construction, operations, and vendor teams. Manage commissioning documentation, testing reports, and system handover processes. Required Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 8 years of relevant commissioning experience. Hands-on experience with Siemens SIMATIC PCS 7 V10 is strictly mandatory. Strong expertise in DCS, SCADA, PLC, and industrial automation systems. Immediate availability for mobilization is strictly mandatory. Preferred Experience Experience in water treatment, desalination/Reverse Osmosis (RO), wastewater treatment/Sewage Treatment Plant (STP), utilities, or industrial infrastructure projects is preferred for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Wajh, Tabuk, supporting the AMAALA Project. The role involves working within a project-focused environment, collaborating with various engineering and operational teams. Application Process Qualified candidates who meet the mandatory requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

084b32ec51131099.description: Operation Manager at ACWA Power ACWA Power is seeking an Operation Manager for a full-time position in An Nu'ayriyah. This role involves leading and managing the operating functions of a CCGT power plant to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations. The Operation Manager will be responsible for adhering to established procedures, contractual requirements, and production schedules, while meeting quality, cost, and performance objectives. Role Overview The Operation Manager will oversee operational planning, workforce management, and plant performance. Key aspects of the role include ensuring compliance with HSE and IMS standards, managing emergency preparedness, and driving continuous improvement in operating activities. This position requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Lead and supervise plant operations, including normal operation, plant start-up, shutdown, planned outages, and emergency activities, ensuring safety for personnel, equipment, and the environment. Ensure efficient plant operation, achieve production schedules, and meet established operational and performance standards, while monitoring operating parameters and maintaining effective operational reporting. Participate in technical decisions related to plant design criteria, specifications, operating methods, modifications, and improvements, recommending changes to procedures and schedules as required. Manage operating resources, workforce allocation, competency development, performance evaluation, training, and on-the-job development to maximize operational effectiveness. Prepare and monitor the plant operating budget and cost control activities, and conduct regular operational meetings to review progress, priorities, issues, schedules, and required actions. Ensure effective implementation of IMS, HSE, environmental, legal, PTW, waste management, PPE, hazard risk assessment, and environmental aspect-impact requirements within the area of responsibility. Lead investigations of incidents, non-conformances, deviations, and operational issues, ensuring root cause analysis and implementation of appropriate corrective and preventive actions. Monitor contractors and subcontractors, support emergency preparedness and mock drills, report IMS and operational performance to management, and drive achievement of plant objectives and continuous improvement. Required Experience A minimum of 13-16 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Environment This is a site-based role located at a remote power plant in An Nu'ayriyah.

08539bf5eb9d8746.description: About the Role Front End Limited Company is seeking a Business Development Manager — Offshore to lead the expansion of its offshore energy portfolio in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is based in the Eastern Province, covering Al Khobar and Dhahran. The primary focus of this role is to secure scopes within Saudi Aramco's Offshore Maintain Potential Program (MPP), with a secondary focus on offshore and marine programs from the Ministry of Transport and Logistic Services and Mawani. The successful candidate will manage the complete business development cycle, from market intelligence and client engagement to opportunity qualification, proposal leadership, commercial negotiation, and contract handover. This involves converting Front End's exclusive partnerships, particularly with Acteon, into pre-qualifications, Long Term Agreements (LTAs), and awarded projects. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a capture plan for Aramco's Offshore MPP work scopes, including platform tie-ins, jackets and decks, MOPU installations, subsea pipeline replacements, brownfield modifications, and platform life-extension campaigns. Map MPP stakeholders across Aramco's Offshore Projects Department, Northern Area Oil Operations (NAOO), Upstream Engineering Services, Marine Department, and Procurement & Supply Chain Management (P&SCM), building relationships at decision-making levels. Track MPP package releases, EPCI tender cycles, and IKTVA expectations, positioning Front End and alliance partners for prequalification (9COM, SAP Ariba), technical evaluation, and award. Lead pursuit strategies for Long Term Agreements (LTAs) and call-off scopes under Aramco's offshore framework contracts for services such as survey, positioning, mooring, foundations, inspection, IRM, and decommissioning. Drive business development for Mawani-led offshore and nearshore programs, including port expansions, marine infrastructure upgrades, dredging support, hydrographic and geophysical surveys, mooring systems, quay-wall and breakwater works, and offshore aids-to-navigation. Engage the Ministry of Transport and Logistic Services on national maritime initiatives aligned with the National Transport and Logistics Strategy (NTLS) and Saudi Vision 2030. Pursue framework agreements, LTAs, and project-specific tenders issued by Mawani and its operating partners. Manage the offshore opportunity pipeline in CRM, forecasting bookings, revenue, and gross margin by program. Lead bid strategy, win themes, pricing posture, and risk allocation in collaboration with Operations, Engineering, Finance, and Legal teams. Oversee proposal development with Front End's proposals team and alliance partners to ensure compliant and competitive submissions. Negotiate LTAs, master service agreements, and call-off contracts, ensuring smooth handover to Project Delivery. Maintain a structured view of Saudi Arabia's offshore market, including Aramco offshore CAPEX/OPEX, Mawani port master plan, and Red Sea/NEOM coastal developments. Monitor competitor activity and integrate insights into positioning and pricing strategy. Identify opportunities for new alliances, technology transfer, and localization to enhance IKTVA scores. Act as Front End's primary commercial interface with offshore alliance partners, coordinating joint pursuits, technical workshops, and client visits. Represent Front End at industry events such as ADIPEC, Saudi Maritime Congress, Aramco supplier forums, and Mawani industry days. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Petroleum, Marine, Civil/Structural, or Subsea), Geoscience, or a related technical discipline. An MBA is an advantage. 8–12 years of business development or commercial experience in the offshore oil & gas or marine sector, with at least 4 years of sales experience in Saudi Arabia. Demonstrated success in closing offshore scopes with Saudi Aramco and/or Mawani / MoT, evidenced by named awards, LTAs, or framework agreements. Strong working knowledge of Aramco's prequalification process (9COM, SAP Ariba, IKTVA), contracting strategies, and offshore technical standards (SAES, SAEP, SAMSS). Familiarity with Mawani tendering and Ministry of Transport procurement processes. Hands-on experience leading complex offshore proposals (EPCI, IRM, survey, mooring, foundations, decommissioning) typically above USD 10 million. Commercial acumen across pricing, contract terms (FIDIC, LOGIC, bespoke Aramco/Mawani forms), risk allocation, and consortium structuring. Preferred Qualifications Candidates with direct familiarity with Saudi Aramco Long Term Agreements (LTAs) and the Offshore Maintain Potential Program will receive higher consideration. This includes evidence of: Previous business development or account-management ownership of an Aramco offshore LTA (survey, mooring, foundations, IRM, or marine construction support), including call-off generation, scope expansion, and renewal. Direct involvement in Maintain Potential Program offshore campaigns such as tie-ins, MOPU/jacket installations, brownfield modifications, pipeline replacements, or platform life-extension work. An established network within Aramco Offshore Projects, NAOO, Marine Department, and the contracting community supporting MPP. A track record of structuring consortium or alliance bids that meet Aramco IKTVA and Saudization requirements. Work Type and Experience This is a full-time position requiring 5-10 years of relevant experience. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

0858078c34c8d436.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة خزام سيف طرجم السهلي للتجارة عن مدير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف العام على الأنشطة الإدارية وضمان سير العمليات اليومية بكفاءة وفعالية عالية، بما يتوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية المعتمدة للمؤسسة. الهدف من الوظيفة يشارك المدير الإداري في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، ويتحمل مسؤولية الإشراف على تخطيط وتنظيم الأعمال الإدارية. يشمل ذلك متابعة كافة العمليات الإدارية ذات الصلة، والتأكد من توفر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لضمان أعلى مستويات الكفاءة والفعالية في الأداء اليومي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في صياغة الأهداف الاستراتيجية للشؤون الإدارية، وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والمشاريع التي تدعم تحقيق هذه الأهداف، مع وضع مقاييس دقيقة لتقييم مستوى الإنجاز. الإشراف على عمليات تطوير ومراجعة جداول الصلاحيات والإجراءات الإدارية بشكل مستمر لتحسينها وضمان تقديم الخدمات الإدارية بالجودة والسرعة المطلوبة. متابعة وتوجيه الأنشطة الهادفة لتلبية احتياجات الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين من الخدمات الإدارية المتنوعة، مثل النقل والضيافة والنظافة، وتنظيم المراسلات والأرشفة، والتشغيل الإداري للمباني والمرافق. ضمان تطبيق الأنظمة والتعليمات والقرارات الإدارية المعمول بها، والتأكد من إبلاغ جميع الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين بالقرارات الصادرة عن الإدارة العليا ومتابعة تنفيذها. الإشراف على إعداد التقارير والملخصات التي توضح نسب الإنجاز العامة في الشؤون الإدارية، وتقديمها للإدارة العليا، مع إطلاعهم على التحديات والمستجدات، واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية الهامة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الإدارة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على تخطيط وتنظيم وإدارة العمليات الإدارية بفعالية. مهارات قوية في المتابعة والتوجيه والإشراف. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في حفر الباطن، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن مؤسسة خزام سيف طرجم السهلي للتجارة. يتطلب الدور العمل ضمن فريق إداري لدعم العمليات اليومية للمؤسسة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

087740f0305883e9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجمع الدار البيضاء الطبي عن أخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتحسين جودة خدمة العملاء، وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء، والمساهمة في وضع الإجراءات والأدلة لضمان رضا العملاء. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. الغرض من الوظيفة يهدف شاغل الوظيفة إلى وضع وتحديد مؤشرات ومعايير الأداء والجودة في خدمة العملاء، والمشاركة في تحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء. كما يشمل الدور تطوير برامج لتعزيز جودة أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نقاط القوة والضعف، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة برضا العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة في خدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة، وضمان المتابعة المستمرة. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية وكفاءة، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تطوير برامج ومبادرات لضمان تجاوز توقعات واحتياجات المتعاملين من حيث جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، بهدف بناء نموذج متكامل. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتحليل نتائج تقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع الخطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء ومعايير الجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف وتحليل بيانات رضا العملاء. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل أخصائي خدمة العملاء ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى مستويات الجودة ورضا العملاء. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقديم على هذه الوظيفة في شركة مجمع الدار البيضاء الطبي.

089da046679ceaee.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة حبوب القهوة المحدودة عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنفيذ العمليات التشغيلية للموارد البشرية بكفاءة عالية، وضمان سير دورة حياة الموظف بشكل كامل من التوظيف وحتى إنهاء الخدمة. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بسياسات الشركة ونظام العمل والعمال السعودي، ودعم استقرار القوى العاملة في بيئة تشغيلية سريعة النمو تعتمد على الدقة وسرعة التنفيذ. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ ومتابعة العمليات اليومية للموارد البشرية وخدمة الموظفين والإدارات. إدارة ملفات وبيانات الموظفين وتحديث السجلات والوثائق وأرشفتها. تنفيذ إجراءات التهيئة ومباشرة الموظفين الجدد واستكمال متطلباتهم. متابعة الحضور والانصراف والإجازات والاستئذانات والغياب وربطها بالرواتب. دعم عمليات الرواتب والمزايا والتأمين الطبي وإعداد الخطابات والتعريفات. إدارة وتحديث بيانات الموظفين على نظام جسر ومتابعة العمليات الوظيفية عليه. تنفيذ ومتابعة المعاملات الحكومية عبر قوى والتأمينات والمنصات ذات العلاقة. متابعة صلاحية العقود والوثائق والالتزام بالمتطلبات النظامية والتوطين. متابعة استفسارات الموظفين والطلبات الإدارية ومعالجة الحالات البسيطة وتصعيد ما يلزم. إعداد التقارير والمراسلات المتعلقة بالموارد البشرية والامتثال. إعداد ونشر الاتصالات الداخلية والتنسيق للفعاليات والمبادرات الخاصة بالموظفين. المحافظة على سرية بيانات الموظفين والالتزام بالسياسات والأنظمة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية. معرفة قوية بأنظمة العمل والعمال السعودي واللوائح ذات الصلة. القدرة على العمل في بيئة سريعة النمو وتتطلب الدقة وسرعة التنفيذ. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل. يتطلب الدور العمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي يدعم استقرار القوى العاملة في الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

08a010ddce0137e5.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Chef de Cuisine to oversee the quality, consistency, and production of the restaurant kitchen in Riyadh. This full-time role involves leading kitchen staff, managing food-related functions, and coordinating menus, purchasing, staffing, and food preparation for the property's restaurant. Key Responsibilities Develop and create new applications, ideas, systems, or products, including artistic contributions for the restaurant. Supervise restaurant kitchen shift operations and ensure compliance with all Food & Beverage policies, standards, and procedures. Maintain food preparation handling and correct storage standards, ensuring proper handling and temperature of all food products. Plan and manage food quantities and plating requirements, estimating daily restaurant production needs. Prepare and cook various types of food, checking the quality of raw and cooked products to meet standards. Determine food presentation and create decorative food displays. Lead shift teams, personally preparing food items and executing requests based on specifications. Supervise and manage restaurant kitchen employees, overseeing day-to-day operations and ensuring productivity. Establish and maintain collaborative relationships with employees, fostering mutual trust and respect. Set and support the achievement of kitchen goals, including performance and budget targets. Provide services that exceed customer expectations, managing daily operations to ensure quality and standards are met. Interact with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels, and handle guest problems and complaints. Identify developmental needs of staff, coaching and mentoring to improve knowledge and skills. Participate in training restaurant staff on menu items, including ingredients and preparation methods. Manage employee progressive discipline procedures and participate in performance appraisals. Qualifications and Requirements Experience: 2-5 years in a culinary leadership role. Ability to lead, influence, and encourage others using strong interpersonal and communication skills. Demonstrated honesty and integrity, leading by example. Analyze information and evaluate results to identify optimal solutions and resolve problems. Attend and participate in all relevant meetings.

08d4591ff1f06a6e.description: Company Description Whole Foods Trading Company has been operating in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, for over 20 years, specializing in agricultural commodities. The role involves answering customer queries, resolving basic issues, and coordinating with the warehouse or inventory team to ensure product availability. The Counter Sales team member will also support promotional activities, assist in merchandising, and follow company policies and safety procedures. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to interact effectively with diverse customers and colleagues. Candidates should possess Sales and Sales Management skills to meet sales targets, manage the sales counter, and support basic inventory and product placement decisions. Candidates should possess Training capabilities to help new team members understand products, processes, and customer service standards. Basic knowledge of agricultural commodities (e.g., pulses, rice, spices) or willingness to learn quickly is beneficial. Prior experience in retail, grocery, or counter sales is preferred but not mandatory. Ability to work on-site in Jeddah, stand for extended periods, and handle cash and POS systems with accuracy. Organizational skills, reliability, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency in Arabic,Urdu/Hindi

0859c00543972b5d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أبدي8 عن مهندس معماري داخلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم التعديلات الهيكلية والأثاث والتجهيزات للمساحات الداخلية، بالإضافة إلى المساعدة في الإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات الداخلية والديكورات، وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات الفنية. إعداد النماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية، وعرضها على العميل مع إجراء التعديلات المطلوبة. المساعدة في عملية اختيار المقاولين والمواد، والإشراف على مراحل التنفيذ لضمان الجودة. تقديم الدعم اللازم لمشروعات تنفيذ التصميمات، ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاولين. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب تقدمها، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية الداخلية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تصميم التعديلات الهيكلية والأثاث والتجهيزات الداخلية. مهارات في إعداد الرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة بريدة، القصيم، ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في شركة أبدي8. عن شركة أبدي8 تلتزم شركة أبدي8 بتقديم حلول تصميم داخلي مبتكرة وعملية، وتسعى لضم مهندسين معماريين داخليين يشاركونها رؤيتها في تحقيق التميز في المشاريع. تقديم الطلبات لمزيد من المعلومات حول هذا الدور أو لتقديم طلبك، يرجى التواصل مباشرة مع شركة أبدي8. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذا المنصب.

0800e90398e6901d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أثر المعرفة الاستشارية عن أخصائي أداء مؤسسي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير منظومة التخطيط الاستراتيجي ومتابعة مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية، ويتطلب خبرة ميدانية مثبتة في بناء الخطط الاستراتيجية وقياس الأداء المؤسسي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد وتحديث الخطط الاستراتيجية ومراجعتها بشكل دوري. بناء وتطوير مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (KPIs) وربطها بالأهداف الاستراتيجية. إعداد التقارير الدورية ولوحات القيادة (Dashboards) الخاصة بمتابعة الأداء. تحليل الفجوات بين الأداء الفعلي والمستهدف، واقتراح خطط التحسين. المشاركة في اجتماعات اللجان الاستراتيجية وتوثيق القرارات والمتابعات. التنسيق مع الإدارات المختلفة لجمع البيانات والتحقق من دقتها قبل الاعتماد. إعداد دراسات المقارنة المعيارية (Benchmarking) مع أفضل الممارسات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الأداء المؤسسي والتخطيط الاستراتيجي. خبرة ميدانية مثبتة في بناء الخطط الاستراتيجية وقياس الأداء المؤسسي. القدرة على تطوير مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية وربطها بالأهداف الاستراتيجية. مهارات تحليلية قوية والقدرة على تحديد الفجوات واقتراح حلول تحسينية. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي الأداء المؤسسي ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة أثر المعرفة الاستشارية، ويساهم بشكل مباشر في تطوير وتحسين الأداء الاستراتيجي للمؤسسات. يقع مقر العمل في مدينة مكة المكرمة بالمملكة العربية السعودية، والوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

08007147d67a4949.description: About the Role St. Regis is seeking an In Villa Dining Head Chef to oversee the daily kitchen operations. Estimate daily production needs weekly and communicate these needs to kitchen personnel daily. Assist the Executive Chef with all kitchen operations and food preparation. Prepare and cook various types of food, for regular service or special guests and functions. Develop, design, or create new applications, ideas, relationships, systems, or products, including artistic contributions to food presentation. Assist in determining food presentation methods and create decorative food displays. Maintain purchasing, receiving, and food storage standards. Ensure compliance with food handling and sanitation standards. Perform duties of kitchen managers and employees as necessary. Recognize superior quality products, presentations, and flavors. 081530b008a4ba48.description: About Lucid Motors Middle East Lucid Motors Middle East is dedicated to advancing mobility through innovation, developing vehicles based on proprietary technology and software-defined architectures. The company focuses on integrating design, engineering, and production in-house across its global operations. This approach aims to redefine automotive segments by combining range, performance, design, and space. Role Overview: Sr Automation Engineer, Powertrain Lucid Motors Middle East is seeking a Sr Automation Engineer, Powertrain, for an internship position in Saudi Arabia. This role involves managing PLC architecture, SCADA, historian systems, MES-OT integration, OT cybersecurity, and Industry deployment for AMP-2 Powertrain equipment, encompassing both Drive Unit and HV Battery assembly shops. The engineer will be responsible for building the automation stack from initial commissioning through volume ramp to the June 2027 SOP, ensuring adherence to standards, uptime, cybersecurity, and data integration for a ************** plant. The position requires 5-10 years of experience and operates under disciplined change control, objective launch evidence, cross-functional problem solving, and structured technical ownership transfer to the Saudi workforce. Key Responsibilities Define and enforce PLC architecture and coding standards for Siemens TIA Portal and Rockwell Studio 5000. Manage safety PLC deployment (Siemens F, Rockwell GuardLogix, Beckhoff TwinSAFE) and ensure functional safety compliance. Maintain PLC program libraries, version-control repositories, and control-system change management. Lead Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) for all automated Powertrain equipment. Own SCADA architecture and standards (Ignition, WinCC, or FactoryTalk View SE) and deploy/maintain historian systems (OSIsoft PI, Ignition Historian, or equivalent) for machine performance data. Manage MES integration for production tracking, quality traceability, and machine-signal integration (OPC-UA, SQL). Enforce OT cybersecurity standards, implement network segmentation, secure remote access, and patch management for OT assets. Drive IIoT deployment, including machine connectivity, digital dashboards, predictive analytics, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) monitoring. Partner with Data Engineering on data pipelines, tags, and analytics use cases, and sponsor Industry applications such as predictive maintenance and closed-loop process control. Deploy and maintain machine vision systems (Cognex, Keyence) for inspection and traceability, and support robot-PLC integration for FANUC and ABB cells. Enforce High Voltage (HV) Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), HVIL continuity, and mandatory HV PPE for work on EV Powertrain equipment. Comply with SASO, Saudi MOI, and functional safety standards, and support HV emergency response procedures. Architect PLC/HMI code, state machines, alarms, diagnostics, recipes, and recovery sequences, conducting peer reviews and enforcing modular coding standards. Own industrial networks, managed switches, addressing, interfaces, time synchronization, and end-to-end MES handshakes. Validate functional safety changes, safety requirement traceability, and proof-test evidence under formal authorization. Support FAT/SAT, commissioning, equipment acceptance, Safe Launch, run-at-rate, and capacity verification with objective evidence. Control production, process, software, and test changes through documented risk assessment, approvals, validation, and revision history. Participate in readiness reviews, Layered Process Audits, and Process Confirmation. Apply role-specific HV LOTO/HVIL, machine safety, stored-energy isolation, electrical safe-work, and PPE requirements. Protect product genealogy, calibrated-tool status, test/measurement integrity, document control, and audit-ready objective evidence. Comply with applicable AMP-2, SASO, Saudi labor/EHS, IATF 16949, IEC 60204, and functional-safety requirements. Build Saudi national capability through structured On-the-Job Training (OJT), skills matrices, practical assessment, certification, cross-training, and documented knowledge transfer. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience in automation engineering. Proficiency in PLC programming (Siemens TIA Portal, Rockwell Studio 5000). Experience with SCADA systems (Ignition, WinCC, or FactoryTalk View SE) and historian systems (OSIsoft PI, Ignition Historian). Knowledge of MES integration and OT cybersecurity standards. Familiarity with IIoT and Industry deployment. Experience with machine vision systems (Cognex, Keyence) and robotics integration (FANUC, ABB). Understanding of HV safety and compliance standards. Work Environment and Collaboration This role is based in a greenfield facility in Saudi Arabia, requiring collaboration across various departments including Production, Quality, Maintenance, Manufacturing Engineering, EHS, IT/OT, MES, Supply Chain, Product Engineering, and external suppliers. The position is an internship, focusing on establishing and maintaining automation systems from the ground up. Compensation Compensation for this role is not disclosed. Lucid offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays; paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program, with awards determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results.

08296545f26e125b.job_title: Passenger Service Agent Flynas TIF Station
08296545f26e125b.description: About the Role Swissport KSA is seeking a Passenger Service Agent for the Flynas TUI Station in Turaif, Northern Frontier. This full-time role involves providing comprehensive passenger and customer services as per contractual agreements, ensuring a positive experience for all travelers. Provide a welcoming service to passengers at check-in and other customer service touch points. Verify travel documentation and check-in departing passengers according to standard operating procedures. Counter-check boarding passes, make announcements, and ensure efficient passenger boarding. Assist customers during flight irregularities such as delays, cancellations, or diversions, coordinating communication to maintain a positive passenger experience. Maintain excellent customer service standards consistently. Perform duties related to Check-In, Gate, Transfers, and Lost & Found. Charge applicable excess baggage fees. Assist passengers through arrival and check-in processes, including those with special needs such as unaccompanied minors (UM), VIPs, and passengers requiring wheelchair assistance. Direct passengers through Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine as required. Manage Gate activities, including set-up, communication with the Flight Coordinator, flight close-out, boarding process, accuracy of final passenger figures, initiating searches for missing passengers, and communicating baggage details for missing passengers. Contribute to the on-time performance of flights by proactively handling Passenger Service matters. Make public address announcements as needed (*, delay, boarding, last call). Assist the Ramp team to ensure wheelchairs, strollers, and gate-checked bags are available for loading upon departure and delivery upon arrival. Adhere to and comply with all Standard Operating Procedures (Swissport & Carrier Specific). Operate equipment such as computer keyboards and carrier-specific reservation/ticketing software. Produce all required work-related documentation. Uphold and protect the company’s interests and image at the Terminal/Airside. Protect customer-supplied products (*, boarding passes, tags, signage) from loss or damage by strictly adhering to written procedures. Ensure compliance with uniform standards and personal protective equipment policies where applicable. Provide relevant information to customer queries and offer solutions to issues impacting the customer’s experience. Report all irregularities to the appropriate supervisor/manager. Carry out any additional duties as instructed by management. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a related field. Ability to perform a wide range of passenger/customer services. Proficiency in operating computer keyboards and carrier-specific reservation/ticketing software. Required Skills Strong customer service orientation. Excellent communication skills for making public address announcements and assisting passengers. Ability to handle flight irregularities and coordinate communication effectively. Attention to detail for verifying travel documentation and managing gate activities. Adherence to standard operating procedures and company policies. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Turaif, Northern Frontier, within an airport terminal and airside environment. The role involves direct interaction with passengers and coordination with various airport teams. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

082c5a08af1c31af.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المشيدون السعوديون للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات للمشاريع الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى تطوير برامج التركيب والتشغيل والصيانة للمعدات والتجهيزات الصناعية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنوات، ويوفر فرصة للمهندسين حديثي التخرج أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة لتطوير مهاراتهم في بيئة عمل احترافية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات التفصيلية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، مع الالتزام بتعليمات الشركات المصنعة ومتابعة إجراءات التنفيذ. المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوثيق نسب التقدم، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة الميكانيكية أو مجال ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0-1 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية. معرفة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل وصيانة التجهيزات والمعدات الميكانيكية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في التحليل وحل المشكلات الهندسية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالدقة والجودة في العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. سيتم العمل ضمن فريق متخصص في مشاريع المقاولات، مع التركيز على تطبيق أفضل الممارسات الهندسية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

085652ba46f1f033.description: About the Role Binzagr Company is seeking a Warehouse Supervisor to join their team in Riyadh. Update Goods Return Note (GRN) serial numbers in the system daily. Report damaged stocks to the Operation Manager for insurance purposes. Ensure accurate and timely delivery of stocks based on invoices. Arrange tyre deliveries using owned and hired transport as per business needs. 08a0a972eccab255.description: About the Role Alrawaf Contracting is seeking an Inventory Control Lead to manage and control the company's construction materials, tools, equipment, machinery, spare parts, and other project assets. This full-time position is based in Al Qassim, Al Qasim, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. The role ensures accurate inventory records, effective asset utilization, and compliance with company policies across various locations. Key Responsibilities Lead day-to-day inventory control across warehouses, yards, and construction sites. Maintain accurate records of construction materials, consumables, spare parts, tools, and equipment. Monitor stock levels, minimum/maximum quantities, and reorder requirements. Conduct regular physical stock counts, cycle counts, and annual inventory audits, investigating and resolving discrepancies. Implement inventory control procedures to minimize losses and excess stock, ensuring proper identification and storage. Maintain an updated asset register for construction equipment, vehicles, tools, machinery, and IT assets. Track asset movements, monitor utilization, condition, and lifecycle, and coordinate transfers, returns, and disposal. Coordinate with project teams regarding equipment and tool availability, deployment, and maintenance. Ensure materials are received, inspected, recorded, and issued according to approved procedures, verifying against purchase orders and delivery notes. Maintain accurate inventory and asset information within the company's ERP/WMS or asset management system. Prepare monthly inventory and asset reports for management, including KPIs and dashboards. Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, project requirements, and KSA regulations. Supervise and guide inventory controllers, storekeepers, and asset coordinators, providing training and promoting accountability. Performance Indicators The role's effectiveness will be measured against several key performance indicators, including: Inventory accuracy percentage and variance. Stock-out frequency and slow-moving/obsolete inventory levels. Inventory turnover and asset utilization rate. Asset loss/damage rate and asset register accuracy. Timeliness of inventory transactions and cycle-count completion. Reduction in inventory carrying costs and compliance with procedures. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in inventory control, asset management, or a related field. Demonstrated experience in managing construction materials, tools, equipment, and machinery. Proficiency in using ERP/WMS or asset management systems. Strong understanding of inventory control procedures and best practices. Ability to lead and train a team effectively. The Delivery Manager will drive performance across scope, schedule, cost, interfaces, and stakeholder coordination from mobilization through commissioning and handback. Establish a strong performance culture across site teams and subcontractors, ensuring clear accountabilities and measurable outputs.
